# Confluence

> Confluence is a free, open-source, interactive machine-learning visualization platform. It runs real scikit-learn models (38 algorithms, 25 datasets) in the browser so learners can see decision boundaries, training behavior, metrics, and explanations instead of reading static math.

Confluence is built with Next.js, FastAPI, and scikit-learn, and is MIT-licensed. The fastest way to understand any concept here is to open the visualizer and run the model.

## Visualize

- [Interactive visualizer](https://confluence.website/app): Run real models, compare algorithms, inspect metrics and explanations.
- [Algorithm encyclopedia](https://confluence.website/algorithms): 38 algorithms across classification, regression, clustering, and dimensionality reduction, each with theory and visuals.
- [Learning roadmap](https://confluence.website/resources): Seven layers from linear algebra to deployment, each pairing readings and videos with the exact visualizer tool to practice on.

## Learn

- [Linear Algebra](https://confluence.website/resources): Vectors, eigenvalues, and decomposition — the language every model computes in.
- [Statistics & Probability](https://confluence.website/resources): Distributions, hypothesis testing, and Bayesian thinking for interpreting results.
- [Optimization](https://confluence.website/resources): Gradient descent, loss functions, and convergence — how models learn.
- [Feature Engineering](https://confluence.website/resources): Scaling, encoding, selection, and dimensionality reduction.
- [Evaluation](https://confluence.website/resources): Accuracy, precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, ROC curves, cross-validation.
- [Model Selection](https://confluence.website/resources): Comparing algorithms and tuning hyperparameters.
- [Deployment](https://confluence.website/resources): Serialization, APIs, monitoring, and MLOps.

## Reference

- [Essential reading](https://confluence.website/resources): Dive into Deep Learning, Distill, fast.ai, Understanding Deep Learning.
- [Source code](https://github.com/mahirmlk): The full open-source repository.
